Najwa · your prayer, remembrance and Quran in one day

Najwa is a daily companion for Muslims that brings together in one app: prayer times with adhan and iqama, silencing the phone during prayer and restoring the ringer as it was, the Madinah mushaf in the King Fahd Complex script, the day and night adhkar, a tasbeeh counter, a prayer and qada log, a khatma plan, and the \"My day\" home screen widget.

• Works without internet: times are calculated on your phone, with no accounts and no ads.
• A mushaf matching the King Fahd Complex edition (Hafs), in its script and text; zooming enlarges the text, which reflows.
• Hoped-for hasanat are shown as a preview only until a qualified scholar approves their rules; they are a hope, not a reckoning.
• Seven languages: Arabic, English, Indonesian, Urdu, Bengali, Hindi and Turkish.

• Quran text and script: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex, Madinah. All rights reserved by the Complex; used in Najwa with its permission.
• Adhkar: "Hisn al-Muslim" by Shaykh Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani (may Allah have mercy on him), with their hadith sources.
• Surah and juz data: the Tanzil project. City directory: GeoNames, licensed CC BY 4.0.
• Interface font: Noto Sans Arabic, SIL OFL. AndroidX and Kotlin components, Apache-2.0. The full licence texts are included in the app.
Prayer times are calculated from the city and method you choose; check them against your local calendar and mosque. Iqama times are reminders you set, not official mosque times.
All your data stays on your phone, and this is everything Najwa uses

Najwa does not request the internet permission at all, so it cannot send anything to any server. No accounts, no ads, no analytics or tracking. We do not collect, sell or share your data, and we have no copy of it.
What is kept on your phone only

• Settings: your city or coordinates, calculation method and adjustments, mosques and iqama minutes, alerts and silence, appearance, language and widgets.
• A small technical log: to restore the ringer after silence and avoid repeated alerts.
• Your worship, if you use it: prayers you mark and qada, what you read in the mushaf with your khatma position, bookmarks and highlights, adhkar and tasbeeh progress, and your goals. Hoped-for hasanat are calculated from these on the phone.
• An adhan sound you pick from your files: a private copy inside the app; we never ask for general access to your files.

• Notifications: to show adhan, iqama and reminders. On Android 16 the iqama countdown may appear in the status bar.
• Exact alarms: so adhan and silence arrive exactly on time.
• Do Not Disturb access and audio settings: to silence the phone during prayer and restore it as it was.
• Start after reboot: to reschedule alerts.
• Foreground service and media playback: to play the adhan and keep silence until it ends.
• Vibration: with alerts and when counting adhkar.
• Approximate location: only when you tap "Find my city", or "More precise: use my current location" on the Qibla page; only the city you choose is kept.
What leaves your phone, only by your choice

• Backup: a file you save wherever you choose, optionally protected with a password (AES-256-GCM encryption). Android's automatic backup is turned off.
• Sharing: the monthly table, the dua of the day or a mosque's details, through the share menu to the app you pick.
• Contact: opens your email app with a ready message that you review and send yourself, including your phone model if you keep it.
• App linking (off by default): when on, Najwa broadcasts prayer stages to automation apps on your phone, so they know your prayer times.
• Widgets and watch: times and your day summary appear on your home screen, and alerts reach your paired watch through the phone's system.

You can turn off any feature, withdraw any permission in the phone\'s settings, and delete your worship records from their settings. Clearing the app\'s data or uninstalling it deletes everything for good; we have no copy. Najwa collects no data from anyone, children included.

Choose your city and method under \"Prayer times\" in Settings, and compare the times with your city\'s calendar. Set iqama under \"Mosque and iqama\", silence under \"Silence during prayer\", and widgets under \"Widgets\". The mushaf and adhkar are in the bottom bar.

Magnetic interference: move away from metal, magnets and magnetic phone cases, then move the phone in a figure 8.
